# scripts/Combat/TrainingDummy.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Combat/TrainingDummy.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Bloodless practice target with optional frontal guard and damage tally.
It reports hit/blocked results, briefly breaks guard on power hits or kicks,
and never loses health or dies.

Base: `StaticBody3D`. Registered class: `none`.

### take_hit

